label: Published closed form (read): lambda and nu of the q qbar -> gamma* g and q g -> gamma* q channels at O(alpha_s), Eq. (10) of Peng, Chang, McClellan and Teryaev, arXiv:1511.08932v3. A closed-form benchmark, not data.

source.citation: J.-C. Peng, W.-C. Chang, R. E. McClellan and O. Teryaev, Interpretation of Angular Distributions of Z-boson Production at Colliders, arXiv:1511.08932v3 [hep-ph] (17 May 2016)
source.location: Eq. (10), page 3 (two-column text, right after 'Using Eq. 7, Eq. 8 and Eq. 9 imply'); the channel labels (q qbar) and (qG) are printed next to each line
source.read_level: full text of the arXiv v3 PDF (text extraction, equations checked against the extracted text)

rational_form.about: each quantity as (n0 + n1 r^2)/(d0 + d1 r^2) with r = qT/Q, transcribed from the printed lines above: [n0, n1, d0, d1]

independence: Peng et al. obtain Eq. (10) from their Eqs. (7)-(9), the same route as the profile; agreement checks the profile's algebra and transcription, not the physics of Eqs. (8)-(9). Eq. (9) is an approximation (Peng et al.: the exact value depends on the parton distributions).
